title: Multiplayer Mimic Horror
description: This multiplayer horror modpack includes everything you need for a great multiplayer horror experiance! Enjoy scary moments with friends as monster lure you in using their voice! Watch out as monsters and other horror mobs can hear you too!
body:
This multiplayer horror modpack includes everything you need for a great multiplayer horror experiance! 

Enjoy scary moments with friends as monster lure you in using their voice!

Watch out as monsters and other horror mobs can hear you too!
